import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase"

export async function normalizar(ids: string[]) {
  const { error } = await supabase
    .from("candidatos")
    .update({ marcador_tse: null })
    .in("id", ids)

  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
}

export async function apagarSobras(slug: string) {
  await supabase.from("pontos_atencao").delete().eq("candidato_slug", slug)
}
